notes.title: Clipped 1.1 Stats Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37061132/eca36b9af30f60b8966f85f9a48bbfcd362e3374.png

It's almost been a week since Clipped was released on steam and already people are speedrunning it, this is for those people.

There is not an in game timer and by popular request an in game fall counter aswell.

DLC will be releasing in the future - stay tuned.
